items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: But Butterbeams and Susie, and they are out of town, you see.

ctx.x: Uh, I know who? We met at, uh, what's his name's house the other night? Uh, Jasper Taylor tells me about, tells me about that. We met, we met at his house, and Jack L. Cooper, well, he's our business manager, you know? Yes. And, uh, there's so many old performers there, but there's none as old as, hardly as us, you know, as together. But Butterbeams and Susie, and they are out of town, you see.
Oh, are they still, uh, around Chicago sometimes, or no? Yes. They live here. They live on.
